embedding_description: Retrieve a single Zuora invoice's fields (amounts, line items, status) by its id. Requires id.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with invoice: a mapping of field names to values.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Show the invoice's key fields; reflects sensitive financial/billing content (data_sensitivity 0.5) — surface for downstream use but never treat as public.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Fetch one Zuora invoice by id.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params: missing id. zuora.object_not_found: no invoice with that id exists. zuora.auth_failed: the OAuth client credentials were rejected.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: zuora.object_not_found: verify the invoice id via list_invoices or data_query.
